This record's members are colby-corver and hank-cobb, its identity note names LOW and the LOW Tag Team Championship, and the card's Other Feds reads LOW; the card's 'AWC Chapter: Founded July 2006' dates the AWC run, which precedes this record's PRIME years.

notes: PTCpedia names this team's finisher per federation — the Blackball (a flapjack from Cobb into a cutter from Korver) at PRIME and the Blutarski Bomb (a diving powerbomb into a neckbreaker) at AWC and Global — and lists the Fratricide as a SIGNATURE move rather than the finisher, describing it as a sidewalk slam from Cobb with a springboard or turnbuckle leg drop from Korver. LOW's own bio card, which this record holds, calls the Fratricide the finisher and describes it the other way round, as a back body drop from Korver with a spinning powerbomb from Cobb. Both readings stand (#sources-disagree). PTCpedia's own three articles for this team and its two members (/promotions/ptc/archive/ptcpedia-delta-upsilon-iota.html, ptcpedia-colby-korver.html and ptcpedia-hank-cobb.html, all captured 20 Aug 2010) are one filled-in template repeated three times — which is why the census's own cross-index paired them as candidate duplicates; they are a tag team and its two members, not one person, and this record's own merge assertion against PRIME's card already carries the join. As the wiki's own secondary account the three articles agree on LOW, AWC, Global and PRIME as the federations, the LOW Tag Team Championship as the only title, "Master of Puppets" by Metallica as the entrance, Digital Mortality (Global) and Jimmy Bonafide (PRIME) as allies and Jason Natas (PRIME) as the rival, and they add three PRIME pay-per-view appearances — Colossus V (with Jimmy Bonafide against Jason Natas and MegaJob), UltraViolence 2008 (against Team V.I.A.G.R.A. and Risk & Reward) and Culture Shock 2008 (as The Dual Halo). None is filed as a structured appearance: the claims are the wiki's own and no held PRIME document answers to them.
